description: Web latency budgets for the moments a user waits on.

history-returning.from: the page opens, on a device that has opened it before
history-returning.to: the Main Chat's history is visible

history-first-visit.from: the page opens, on a device that has never opened it
history-first-visit.to: the Main Chat's history is visible

computer-return.from: the Computer tab is shown again, after another profile tab or closing the profile

computer-cold.from: the Computer tab is opened on a chat whose computer is asleep

send-acknowledged.to: the user's message and a working indicator are on screen

first-token-ours.to: RUN_STARTED, plus the relay of the provider's first token: the share before and after the provider's own time to first token

provider-first-token.from: the request reaches the model provider

turn-first-progress.to: the Turn's first reasoning summary or tool row is on screen

orchestrationOverhead.description: Each Turn case's Orchestration Overhead up to its first model dispatch over the last day, a case breaching only with minTurns Turns behind it; the gap between a multi-call Turn's model calls is reported beside it. Cold: its process's first Turn within coldWithinMs of the process starting. Main-size: mainHistoryMessages or more. Single or multi: one model call, or several.
